attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as a DHCP server on a new private network (10.10.10.0/24) shared with node2/node3 over their eth1 NICs, and configured node2/node3 to obtain their eth1 address via DHCP instead of remaining unconfigured, entirely via an Ansible playbook run from node4 (the only node with Ansible, designated control_node). Verified end-to-end lease assignment, then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart/recovery protocol on all four managed nodes, confirming boot-identity changes and post-restart recovery of the DHCP service and leases. Also flagged a suspicious external tampering of a local sandbox file (/tmp/inventory.ini) that was silently rewritten with bogus IPs; it was not used for any actual cluster action.
